description.value: The Dixon Entrance Maritime Museum in Masset, Haida Gwaii, is housed in a historic 1914 building — the first on the islands with a concrete foundation, originally the island's first hospital. Its collections span commercial fishing, boat-building, whaling, and cannery history donated by local families, and it claims the oldest European-made artifact found in British Columbia, dredged near Langara Island. The museum also partners with the Council of the Haida Nation on language revitalization, weaving Indigenous and settler maritime heritage into a single compelling stop on Haida Gwaii.
